title: DRAFT - replace owner decisions before freezing
scientific_question: At a fixed nightly review budget, does the locked comparison ranking improve independently adjudicated useful-candidate yield over the locked reference ranking on a later real-sky cohort?
hypotheses: The lower confidence bound for the paired precision-at-budget improvement exceeds the prespecified minimum useful effect.
Safety-gate failures, unresolved outcomes, and review workload do not worsen beyond prespecified limits.

cohort.population: Every object reaching the frozen eligibility boundary during the declared acquisition windows, including rejected, unreviewed, unresolved, and service-failure records.
inclusion_criteria: Point-in-time input and acquisition provenance are complete.
Physical-entity alias group is assigned before splitting.
Candidate was processed by the frozen pipeline and configuration.
exclusion_criteria: Corrupt source bytes that fail the frozen input schema.
Duplicate alias of an already enrolled physical entity under the declared estimand.

endpoints.primary: Paired precision at the nightly review budget using independent mature binary outcome evidence.
secondary: Recall at budget and average precision.
Reviewer minutes, abstention, disagreement, and stale or failed evidence blocks.
Yield by alert age, cadence, brightness, band coverage, sky region, and outcome-missingness stratum.
